name: RefCOCO
description: Dataset for referring expression comprehension, pairing COCO images with natural-language expressions referring to objects and corresponding bounding-box annotations. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Yu, L., Poirson, P., Yang, S., Berg, A. C., & Berg, T. L. (2016). Modeling Context in Referring Expressions. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 69–85. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-46448-0_5

license.identifier: Custom RefCOCO terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The upstream repository provides access instructions but does not identify the dataset license with a standard SPDX identifier. Review upstream terms and the underlying COCO image rights before use or redistribution.
